Messages.Author: cnislev
Messages.Body:
Hi guys

I have played cel pro decks for a while, gradually putting in more and
more guns and now ending up with a cel gun deck with a bit of protean.
Its built on bits of ideas from different people + my own experience,
would love some comments:

Name: Ellen's on your track

Crypt:
4 Ellen Fence
2 Darrel Boyce
2 Skryta Zyleta
2 Scarlett Carson O'Toole
2 Steve Booth

Ellen comes out, concealed desert eagle, scatter shot in the magazine.
Close range with flesh of marble, shoot for 4 and Blur. Earth meld +
psyche for multirush

Library (80 Cards)

12 Masters:
1 Yawp Court
3 Fame
2 Tension in the Ranks
4 Blood Doll
1 Dreams of the Sphinx
1 Vast Wealth

51 Combat:
7 Concealed weapon
6 Scattershot
6 Magazine
7 Flesh of Marble
5 Earth Meld
9 Psyche
7 Blur
4 Taste of Vitae

5 Bum's Rush
5 Rumble

7 Desert Eagle

- I think Manstopper Rounds are better than Scatter Shot (should
probably put them in instead), I like the stability regardless of range
- even Glaser rounds are quite good with additional strikes. And then I
do not have to worry about manouvering to close range but can stick to
Desert Eagles instead of Magnums.

80 cards to keep it simple and focused.

Christian

(oh, and its my first post here, so if I'm writing stuff that other
people have already discussed, sorry!)

>1 Dreams of the Sphinx

I have no real objections to any of this except the Vast Wealth.
You should be entering combat or bleeding, not searching your library.
I would replace it with Guardian Angel or Flak Jacket. One point of
aggravated damge from a hand strike will also put you down, currently.
GA and FJ are really more valuable than you would first guess when you
have them in a deck that intends to be in many combats.

I would also prefer an Elder Library to the Vast Wealth. Permanent
hand size increase will help keep your combos flowing. Others will
recommend The Barrens, for the mid-turn cycle to keep your turn going.

I agree with swapping Scatter Shot out and Manstopper Rounds in. You
have no ability to maneuver, so if your opponent goes long, you lose
half of your striking ability. Ammo that is not range dependent will
be an improvement.

> psyche for multirush

Viability of this type of deck (Earth Meld/Psyche), (Short Range
Gun/Psyche) and (Magazine/any crap ammmo) aside, I offer a simple
suggestion that will improve it's function.

Infernal Pursuit x5-6, taking you from 80 to 85-6 cards.

You'll cycle into guns/conceal and/or magazine/ammo when you need them,
and dump them when you don't. With Psyche as a continuation vehicle,
you can control the number of cards you end up dumping.

I would also consider Tension in the Ranks and/or Dragonbound, since
you lack any real ousting mechanism.

As the Lasombra says, you'll be interested in hand size (even more than
cycling because you're running combos, though Infernal Pursuit is a
no-brainer) - so I would up the number of Dreams to 2-3.

Darby

Messages.Author: Azel
Messages.Body:
everyone pretty much covered what i would say. though ther's a few
options that i'd suggest to explore. here's just a few unmentioned
alternatives:

you might be able to squeeze a Red List, though try Haven Uncovered first.

you have huge amounts of CEL. oddly enough, i think Distraction would be
a nice add here. either get your desired combo or tap an annoying minion
of your predator or prey.

another option looking at CEL, Flurry of Action. either forward pressure
and flush, or forward pressure and ready for rush. yeah, it can be
blocked, but is that such a bad thing? think of it as a flexible rush card.

i'm sure someone said it, but haven't seen it. where's Pulled Fangs?
follow the path of least resistance and let this card do your extra effort.

how many minions do you end up having out? and how many end up
tapped/untapped each turn? because, as i'm not seeing enough dogpile
rush like Haven Uncovered, etc., i'm thinking a pair of small caps would
be untapped. are we needing more rush? or perhaps defense? could we
shake up rush by mixing in Games of Instinct? defense by adding Rooftop
Shadow or Aversion?

some information about what's going on in your metagame will help.
